stories.title: Thailand may rewrite exchange rules to keep Bitcoin ETF gains onshore
stories.summary: A report says Thailand is rewriting stock exchange rules to keep wealth from Bitcoin ETFs inside the country. The single available report does not detail the exact mechanism or timeline. It is not yet confirmed by Thai regulators.
stories.whyItMatters: A government moving to wall off crypto ETF gains within its borders would be an unusual capital-control angle on crypto regulation.
whatToWatch: Official confirmation from Thai regulators or the exchange
Specific rule text once published
Reaction from ETF issuers operating in Thailand
questions: What exactly would trigger the restriction, and how would it be enforced?

sources.title: Thailand is rewriting its stock exchange rules to trap billions in Bitcoin ETF wealth strictly inside its own borders

stories.title: Galaxy launches retail crypto-backed credit lines on Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana
stories.summary: Galaxy has opened retail credit lines that let customers borrow against Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana holdings. This extends crypto-collateralized lending, previously more common with institutions, to individual retail users.
stories.whyItMatters: Retail crypto lending adds leverage to the market, a factor worth watching given past blowups tied to lending platforms.
whatToWatch: Uptake of the product among retail users
Published loan-to-value and liquidation terms
Any regulatory scrutiny of retail crypto lending
questions: What are the liquidation terms if collateral value drops sharply?

sources.title: Galaxy Opens Retail Crypto-Backed Credit Lines on Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana

stories.title: New Bitcoin quantum-resistance proposal SHRINCS comes with a tradeoff
stories.summary: A Bitcoin Improvement Proposal called SHRINCS has been published, aiming to make Bitcoin resistant to quantum-computing attacks. Cointelegraph reports the approach comes with a catch, though the source does not spell out the tradeoff in detail.
stories.whyItMatters: Quantum resistance is a long-term security question for Bitcoin, and how the community weighs proposals like this shapes future protocol upgrades.
whatToWatch: Developer and community review of the SHRINCS proposal
Comparisons with other quantum-resistance efforts, including StarkWare's mainnet test
questions: What exactly is the tradeoff the proposal requires?
Would adoption need a hard fork?

sources.title: SHRINCS BIP published: Quantum-secure Bitcoin comes with a catch

stories.title: StarkWare tests a quantum-resistant Bitcoin transaction on mainnet
stories.summary: StarkWare ran a test of a quantum-resistant Bitcoin transaction on Bitcoin's mainnet. It is an early practical experiment addressing the threat quantum computing could eventually pose to Bitcoin's cryptography.
stories.whyItMatters: Moving quantum-resistance work from theory to a live mainnet test is a concrete step, relevant alongside other proposals like SHRINCS.
whatToWatch: Published results or analysis of the test
Whether other developers build on or replicate it
questions: Does this approach change transaction size or cost?

sources.title: StarkWare tests quantum-resistant Bitcoin transaction on mainnet

stories.title: Solana cuts block confirmation times in first step toward sub-second speed
stories.summary: Solana has cut block confirmation times across its network, described as a first step toward sub-second finality. The change is part of ongoing performance upgrades to the network.
stories.whyItMatters: Faster confirmation directly affects trading, DeFi and payments use cases, where Solana competes on speed with rival chains.
whatToWatch: Further upgrades toward the sub-second target
Validator adoption and network stability after the change
questions: What tradeoffs, if any, come with faster confirmation times?

sources.title: Solana takes its first step toward sub-second speed by cutting block confirmation times across the network

stories.title: SEC's proposed crypto rules probably won't spark a new ICO boom
stories.summary: Cointelegraph reports that the SEC's proposed crypto rules are unlikely to trigger a new wave of ICO fundraising, despite the regulatory easing. The piece pushes back on expectations that looser rules alone will revive token-sale activity.
stories.whyItMatters: A useful check on hype that regulatory clarity by itself reignites speculative fundraising cycles.
whatToWatch: Final form of the SEC's proposed rules
Market reaction once rules take effect
questions: What specifically in the rules limits an ICO revival?

sources.title: SEC’s proposed crypto rules probably won’t spark new ICO boom

stories.title: Cardano and Solana episodes expose a weakness in crypto governance
stories.summary: CryptoSlate argues that recent governance episodes on Cardano and Solana reveal a shared weakness in how crypto protocols make decisions. The supplied report does not detail the specific incidents beyond this framing.
stories.whyItMatters: Governance failures affect confidence in decentralized decision-making, especially when protocols must respond quickly to bugs or disputes.
whatToWatch: Any governance reforms proposed by the Cardano or Solana communities
questions: What specific governance episodes prompted this comparison?

sources.title: Cardano and Solana just exposed crypto governance’s biggest weakness

stories.title: Bitcoin node database could shrink 40 GB, and a related fee-concentration risk surfaces
stories.summary: A CryptoSlate report describes a Bitcoin node database that could shrink by 40 GB, but only for node runners who rebuild it. A related CryptoSlate piece separately flags a security risk that arises when one block collects far more transaction fees than the next.
stories.whyItMatters: Both touch on the health of Bitcoin's base layer: storage costs for node operators and fee-driven incentives that can affect miner behavior and security.
whatToWatch: Uptake of the database rebuild among node operators
Further analysis of the fee-concentration risk
questions: What mechanism produces the 40 GB savings?
How significant is the fee-disparity risk in practice?

sources.title: A hidden Bitcoin node database just shrank by 40 GB, but only if runners rebuild it
Bitcoin’s security risk starts when one block gets far more fees than the next

stories.title: SEC sends crypto custody rule overhaul to White House for review
stories.summary: The SEC has sent a proposed overhaul of crypto custody rules to the White House for review. This is a procedural interagency step that precedes formal rulemaking.
stories.whyItMatters: Custody rules govern how exchanges, funds and institutions hold client crypto assets, making this a concrete regulatory milestone to track.
whatToWatch: Outcome and timeline of the White House review
Publication of a formal proposed rule
An industry comment period once proposed
questions: What specifically would change from current custody requirements?

sources.title: SEC sends crypto custody rule overhaul to White House for review

stories.title: Ethereum developers propose deposit contract overhaul to quantum-proof staking
stories.summary: Ethereum developers have proposed an overhaul of the network's deposit contract to make staking resistant to quantum computing. Decrypt reports this as part of a broader push across major blockchains to prepare for future quantum threats.
stories.whyItMatters: Staking underpins Ethereum's security model, so quantum-proofing it is a long-term priority for the network's resilience.
whatToWatch: Developer discussion and consensus on the proposal
Any timeline set for implementation
questions: How would existing validators be affected during a transition?

sources.title: Ethereum Devs Propose Deposit Contract Overhaul to Quantum-Proof Staking

stories.title: Better launches Bitcoin-backed mortgages powered by Coinbase
stories.summary: Mortgage lender Better has launched Bitcoin-backed mortgages using Coinbase for the crypto infrastructure. The product lets borrowers use Bitcoin holdings as collateral for a home loan.
stories.whyItMatters: This extends crypto further into mainstream consumer lending, another sign of Bitcoin being used as collateral in traditional finance.
whatToWatch: Customer uptake and published loan terms
Whether other lenders introduce similar products
questions: What happens to the loan if Bitcoin's price falls sharply?

sources.title: Better launches Bitcoin-backed mortgages powered by Coinbase

stories.title: Strategy's MSTR outperforms Bitcoin's rally toward $80,000 as STRC nears $100
stories.summary: Strategy's stock, MSTR, has outperformed Bitcoin during its rally toward $80,000, according to CryptoSlate. The report also notes the company's STRC instrument is approaching $100.
stories.whyItMatters: Strategy is widely watched as a leveraged proxy for Bitcoin exposure in equity markets, relevant to anyone tracking corporate Bitcoin treasury strategies.
whatToWatch: Whether MSTR's outperformance versus Bitcoin continues
Whether STRC reaches $100
questions: What is driving MSTR's outperformance beyond Bitcoin's price move?
